description: Turn a list of sku or role lines into invoice_create-ready and quote_create-ready items priced from the catalogue as of each line's date. An unknown code is refused by name and never priced. Free.

client.description: Client name or id, copied into both payloads. invoice_create and quote_create both need one

currency.description: The currency for every line. Defaults to the shared business profile's

date.description: The day the whole list is priced as of, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today

lines.description: The lines to price, each a sku with a quantity or a role with hours

currency.description: Overrides the call's currency for this line. Every line on one payload must agree

date.description: The day this line is priced as of, YYYY-MM-DD. Overrides the call's date

description.description: Override the catalogue name on the customer's document

hours.description: Hours worked, for a role line

quantity.description: How many, for a sku line

role.description: A rate card role. One of sku or role, never both

sku.description: A catalogue code or product name. One of sku or role, never both

tier.description: Price tier for this line. Overrides the call's tier

tax_rate.description: VAT percent for lines whose SKU carries no rate of its own, overriding the shared profile

tier.description: Price tier for every line. Default standard

name: lines_resolve
title: Price lines from the catalogue
